q: What are the happy hour drink specials at The Lobby Tiki Bar?
a: Happy hour specials include $10 cocktails and wines, $5 beers, and $15 bites including Wings, Ceviche, and a Chicken Caesar Wrap. Thursday features $6 Mai Tais all day. Tuesday is Tiki Taco Tuesday with $6 tacos and $5 wells from open to close.
